title: Code-Mixed Phonetic Perturbations for Red-Teaming LLMs
reasoning: The paper focuses on a security-oriented red-teaming method (CMP-RT) to bypass LLM safety filters. While it uses harmful prompt categories such as 'Religious Hate' to test if filters can be bypassed, its primary objective is identifying architectural vulnerabilities in tokenization and cross-modal safety alignment rather than evaluating religion, faith, ethics, or moral reasoning.
